package autochess

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func testState(t *testing.T) State {
	t.Helper()
	ids := [Seats]int64{}
	for i := range ids {
		ids[i] = int64(i + 1)
	}
	s, e := New(ids, DemoRules(), fmt.Sprintf("%064x", 17), 1800000000000)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return s
}
func TestAutoChessMergeSellAndPoolConservation(t *testing.T) {
	s := testState(t)
	for i := range s.Seats {
		s.returnShop(i)
	}
	p := &s.Seats[0]
	for j := range p.Units {
		p.Units[j] = Unit{1, 1}
		s.Pool[0]--
	}
	p.Level = 3
	p.merge()
	if p.Units[0] != (Unit{1, 9}) {
		t.Fatal("chain merge failed")
	}
	if e := s.Validate(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	r, _, e := s.Apply(1, Command{Seq: 1, Epoch: 1, Round: 1, Kind: "sell", A: 0}, s.LastAt)
	if e != nil || r.Gold != 19 || s.Pool[0] != s.Rules.Units[0].Copies {
		t.Fatal("sell did not return nine copies", e)
	}
}
func TestAutoChessCombatReplayOddByeAndElimination(t *testing.T) {
	s := testState(t)
	for i := range s.Seats {
		s.returnShop(i)
		s.Seats[i].HP = 3
	}
	s.Seats[7].HP = 0
	s.Seats[7].Rank = 8
	s.Seats[0].Units[0] = Unit{3, 9}
	s.Pool[2] -= 9
	s.startBattle(s.LastAt)
	if len(s.Fights) != 4 || s.Fights[3].B != -1 {
		t.Fatal("odd bye missing")
	}
	for _, f := range s.Fights {
		if f.B >= 0 {
			w, d := Resolve(s.Rules, f)
			if w != f.Winner || d != f.Damage {
				t.Fatal("replay differs")
			}
		}
	}
	if e := s.Advance(s.Deadline); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if s.Seats[1].HP != 0 || s.Seats[1].Rank != 7 || s.Seats[6].HP != 3 {
		t.Fatal("elimination / bye wrong")
	}
	if e := s.Validate(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}
func TestAutoChessStrictDecodeAndBoundedRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	s := testState(t)
	raw := s.Encode()
	for _, bad := range []string{raw + "{}", strings.Replace(raw, "\"Schema\":1", "\"Schema\":2", 1), strings.Repeat("x", 256*1024+1)} {
		if _, e := Decode(bad); e == nil {
			t.Fatal("bad state accepted")
		}
	}
	s.Pool[0]++
	if _, e := Decode(s.Encode()); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("invented copies accepted")
	}
	s = testState(t)
	now := s.LastAt + 3600000
	if e := s.Advance(now); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	bad := s
	bad.Fights = append([]Fight(nil), s.Fights...)
	bad.Fights[0].Damage++
	if _, e := Decode(bad.Encode()); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("forged battle result accepted")
	}
	if s.Round != 1 || s.Phase != "battle" || s.Deadline != now+s.Rules.BattleMillis {
		t.Fatal("offline fast-forwarded entire match")
	}
}
func TestAutoChessCatalogReloadDoesNotRepriceFrozenMatch(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	r := DemoRules()
	write := func() {
		b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
		if e := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "chess.json"), b, 0600); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	write()
	store, e := OpenCatalog(dir)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	old, e := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	s := testState(t)
	r.Version = "new"
	r.Units[0].Cost++
	write()
	if _, e = store.Load(context.Background()); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	newRules, e := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if e != nil || newRules.Hash() == old.Hash() || s.Rules.Hash() != old.Hash() {
		t.Fatal("snapshot changed", e)
	}
	r.Units[0].Copies = 0
	write()
	if _, e = store.Load(context.Background()); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid rules accepted")
	}
}
